_meta.description: Ramp OAuth 2.0 client-credentials MINT/RE-MINT. Ramp's client_credentials grant issues a Bearer access token with NO refresh token — expiry is handled by re-running the same grant. POST to the token endpoint with HTTP Basic client auth (base64(client_id:client_secret)) and a form body grant_type=client_credentials + the space-delimited `scope`. Response: access_token (ramp_tok_… format), token_type, expires_in 864000 (10 days), scope echo. Doc-derived; tokens are placeholders.
_meta.source: doc:https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/reference/rest/token + https://docs.ramp.com/developer-api/v1/authorization (POST /developer/v1/token, Basic client auth, grant_type=client_credentials + scope; response access_token/token_type/expires_in/scope, NO refresh_token for this grant; client-credentials tokens live 10 days = 864000s)
